latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of Video Editing AI Maker.

- Instantly edit and export polished videos with AI—just upload your clips and describe the edit you want.
- Supports major video formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4 files.
- No editing skills required: handles pause removal, transitions, highlight reels, and more via simple text instructions.
- Built-in secure backend workflow: handles anonymous token generation, session management, uploads, credits, exports, and error handling.
- Designed for content creators and marketers who need professional results fast, without complex software or local installation.
